Name: Wooden Shelves
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10855]Furniture Display Framework[/url] that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to add the following display furniture:

[list]
[*]Wooden Shelf - a single three-slot wooden shelf
[*]Double Wooden Shelf - two three-slot wooden shelves
[*]Triple Wooden Shelf - three three-slot wooden shelves
[/list]
Each of the shelves is purchasable from Robin's store.
﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
